Fog descends like a ghostly shroud,  
Wrapping the world in its misty cloud.  
It blurs the edges of every sight,  
Cloaking the day in a veil of night.  
Shapes and forms are lost to view,  
As the fog engulfs everything it can ensue.  
It's a mysterious presence, ever-changing,  
A natural wonder that's always engaging.
